name: Customer reacts to reporting or ID requirements
description: Customer reduces a transaction, splits it, or leaves when asked for ID, source of funds or told a report may be filed.
fp: May have innocent explanations; assess in context of customer profile and other indicators.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering Typologies and Methods (general placement guidance)
FinCEN, Guidance on structuring and Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) reporting (general)
AUSTRAC, Guidance on structuring and threshold transaction reports (general)

links.name: Customer reacts to reporting or ID requirements
links.ctx: Customer reduces a transaction, splits it, or leaves when asked for ID, source of funds or told a report may be filed.
links.fp: Privacy concerns or lack of documents with the customer may explain some cases.
